title: approvals: a `user` approver naming a nonexistent user id opens a request on a phantom slot with no warning and no onEmptyApprovers fork, so the request is stuck pending forever
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcTp5wXse9Zwgq8aFWV

QA-source: #27392 · approvals.approver-resolution-matrix · observed beside the clauses

## What happens

Graph approver types (department, team, queue, position, manager) that expand to nobody now log a warning and take the node's `onEmptyApprovers` fork, which defaults to `admin_rescue`. A `user` approver has no such path. When its value names no existing user, the request opens with `pending_approvers: ["usr_does_not_exist"]`:
- no warning is logged;
- no admin_rescue routing happens;
- `pending_approver_names` is null.

No person can ever decide the request, and nothing tells the author or an administrator why. This is the silent-stuck class that #3807 and #22824 retired for the graph types.

## Reproduction (fresh showcase boot, admin bearer)

1. Read any project id: `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_project?limit=1`.
2. `POST /api/v1/automation` with `{"name":"qa_v_phantom","label":"QA phantom","type":"autolaunched","status":"active","nodes":[{"id":"start","type":"start","label":"Start","config":{"objectName":"showcase_field_zoo","triggerType":"record-after-create"}},{"id":"appr","type":"approval","label":"Approve","config":{"approvers":[{"type":"user","value":"usr_does_not_exist"}]}},{"id":"end","type":"end","label":"End"}],"edges":[{"id":"e1","source":"start","target":"appr"},{"id":"e2","source":"appr","target":"end"}]}` → success.
3. `POST /api/v1/data/showcase_field_zoo` with `{"name":"qa-v-phantom-1","f_master_detail":"PROJECT_ID"}` → 201.
4. `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests?status=pending`.

- **Expected:** a warning that the approver expanded to nobody, then the `onEmptyApprovers` fork (admin_rescue: the request opens on the organization's administrators, with the routed-to-administrators system comment), as for every graph type.
- **Actual:** a pending request with `pending_approvers: ["usr_does_not_exist"]`, `pending_approver_names` null, and 0 matching lines in the server log.

This was reproduced twice at `c4c515ad`, on two independent boots and databases.

## Mechanism

`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts`, approver expansion (around L2422): `if (type === 'user') { return this.applyOooDelegation(String(a.value), …) }`. The value goes straight into the slate as a slot, and nothing checks that the id resolves to a user. So the empty-slate detection that drives `onEmptyApprovers` never sees an empty slate.

## Where a fix would go

Check that a `user` approver's id exists in the organization, as the graph types are checked. If it does not, warn and drop the slot, so that a slate left empty takes the declared fork. A publish-time lint for a literal user id that does not resolve would catch the authoring half too.

Full evidence chain: QA run #27392.
